adjudication_protocol: Reconciles Annotator A & B independent normative profiles prior to model execution.

pkg_11_physics_thermodynamics.topic: The Carnot Cycle, Maximum Theoretical Efficiency, and Entropy
pkg_11_physics_thermodynamics.declared_objective: Explain the four reversible thermodynamic processes of the Carnot cycle, derive the theoretical thermal efficiency eta = 1 - T_C/T_H from the First and Second Laws, calculate work output and heat rejected in numerical engine cycles, and evaluate the Clausius inequality and entropy generation in irreversible cycles and near absolute zero.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Definitions of thermal reservoirs, heat engine, heat absorbed/rejected, and work.

MEANING.rationale: Carnot principle: maximum theoretical efficiency of reversible heat engines.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Four thermodynamic processes: 2 reversible isothermals and 2 reversible adiabatics on P-V diagram.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Net work enclosed in P-V cycle, First Law energy conservation W = Q_H - Q_C.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Derivation of eta = 1 - T_C/T_H using isothermal heat and adiabatic volume relations.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Numerical cycle calculation for temperatures, efficiency, heat rejected, and work.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Second Law boundaries: Clausius inequality for irreversible cycles and entropy generation.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Reversed Carnot cycle as refrigerator/heat pump outside single-lecture core.

pkg_12_pharmacology_clearance.topic: One-Compartment Intravenous Pharmacokinetics: Clearance and Half-Life
pkg_12_pharmacology_clearance.declared_objective: Formulate the one-compartment intravenous bolus pharmacokinetic model, derive the plasma concentration decay equation C(t) = C_0 * e^(-k_e * t), calculate volume of distribution and total clearance, solve multi-step dosage half-life calculations, and evaluate non-linear Michaelis-Menten elimination saturation in clinical overdoses.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Naming pharmacokinetics, IV bolus, clearance, volume of distribution, half-life.

MEANING.rationale: One-compartment open kinetic model concept and homogeneous drug distribution.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Fundamental PK parameters: Dose, C_0, V_d, k_e, CL, t_1/2.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Multi-parameter coordination between clearance, volume of distribution, and half-life: CL = k_e * V_d and multi-compartment interaction.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Derivation of first-order exponential decay C(t) = C_0 * e^(-k_e*t) and t_1/2 = 0.693/k_e.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Clinical dosage calculations: calculating V_d, CL, half-life, and remaining concentration.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Capacity-limited non-linear Michaelis-Menten elimination saturation in clinical overdoses.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Multi-dose accumulation and chronic dosing regimens outside bolus lecture scope.

pkg_13_logic_predicates.topic: First-Order Predicate Logic: Quantifiers, Variable Binding, and Semantics
pkg_13_logic_predicates.declared_objective: Translate complex English statements into first-order predicate logic with nested quantifiers, specify model structures M = <D, I> to evaluate the truth of quantified formulas, prove validity of quantifier inference rules, and evaluate pathological edge cases involving empty domains and vacuous quantification.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Constants, variables, predicate symbols, universal and existential quantifiers.

MEANING.rationale: Meaning of universal and existential quantification, quantifier negation dualities.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Model-theoretic structure M = <D, I>, interpretation function, and variable assignment g.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Tarskian satisfaction conditions for quantified sentences and scope/variable binding.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Semantic soundness proof of quantifier inference rules (Universal Instantiation).

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Translating natural language statements and evaluating truth in concrete model structures.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Pathological edge cases: empty domains of discourse, vacuous truth, and Free Logic limits.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Higher-order logic extensions and non-classical logics outside introductory FOL scope.

pkg_14_signal_processing_fourier.topic: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and Nyquist-Shannon Sampling Theorem
pkg_14_signal_processing_fourier.declared_objective: Formulate the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) analysis equation, calculate frequency bin indices and spectral resolution for discrete sampling windows, prove the Nyquist-Shannon sampling criterion to prevent spectral aliasing, and evaluate anti-aliasing filter roll-off and finite-record spectral leakage.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Continuous signal, discrete sampled sequence, sampling frequency f_s, interval T_s.

MEANING.rationale: Frequency domain decomposition concept and complex harmonic representation.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: DFT analysis equation, twiddle factors, frequency bin spacing Delta f = f_s / N.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Nyquist-Shannon sampling criterion: spectral replication and aliasing folding f_s > 2 f_max.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Mathematical proof of sampling theorem via Dirac comb impulse train convolution.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Worked numerical calculation of DFT coefficients and frequency bin identification.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Anti-aliasing analog filter roll-off limits, transition bands, and window spectral leakage.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) Cooley-Tukey butterfly algorithms outside basic DFT scope.
